text: {"name":"tx_slot_alloc","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Allocates and initializes a record for an empty transmit slot, stores it in the slot table, and schedules its embedded timer; returns zero if the slot is occupied or allocation fails.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v3":"slot_entry_addr","v5":"slot_index","v7":"allocated_record","v8":"slot_record","v9":"config_table","v10":"timer_delay_base"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"Timer delay base copied from the configuration table."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"16-bit value supplied by the caller."},{"offset":10,"meaning":"Low six bits of the caller-supplied value."},{"offset":12,"meaning":"Transmit slot index."},{"offset":272,"meaning":"Embedded timer or work item passed to the scheduling helper."},{"offset":276,"meaning":"Timer-related metadata initialized from a global value."},{"offset":280,"meaning":"Back-pointer to the containing record."},{"offset":408,"meaning":"Start of the per-slot record pointer table in the owning context."}]}
